- `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`: new test `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNoStock`. It follows your example: nuts taken to zero and screws set to zero leave only "Bolt 10" in WH-1, and `getQuantity` for nuts still returns 0.
